description: Cadence Design Systems, Inc. is a global technology leader that develops computational, AI-driven software, accelerated hardware and silicon intellectual property products and solutions. Its customers include semiconductor companies that design and manufacture integrated circuits, as well as systems companies that design and manufacture electromechanical systems containing various types of semiconductor and other electronics, and its products and solutions empower customers to design, verify and bring to life new and innovative products. Its mission is to empower the world's most innovative companies to deliver extraordinary electronic products that drive the global economy and improve everyday life, and aligned with its Intelligent System Design strategy it organizes its offerings into three tightly integrated product categories: Core EDA, Semiconductor IP, and System Design and Analysis.
